_README: API-free validation of Run B Stage 2 (planning/modality-bridge-2026-10-07-stage2.md), made 2026-10-07/08 on sapphire from a disposable worktree at origin/main (git_head fields) plus the uncommitted Stage 2 launcher, and from sparse worktrees at the original verifier legs' commits. No API call was made: the verifier rehearsal ran under scripts/verifier_dryrun_harness.py (sockets blocked, SDK client stubbed); no API key was reachable from the worktree. Sections: union_validation (the four original unions rebuilt by scripts/modality_bridge_union.py from their own layout and from a batch-layout replica with decoy chunks, compared with the committed unions), crop_reextraction (run_pv.py extract of each committed union against the original crops; provenance), verifier_rehearsal (per original leg: the Stage 2 batch dry run at HEAD on the full original crop manifest, the original commit's real-time request captured on candidates 0-2, and the field-by-field comparison), verifier_signatures (tile-elided request signature per verifier, enforced by the launcher), anchor_gate (scripts/modality_bridge_anchors.py via the launcher), disjoint_k5_spread, and launcher_tests (stand-in Stage 1 tree built from the original passes).
